description.en: Reported revenue for the trailing twelve months ending on the report period date.
description.zh: 采用截至报告期末的最近十二个月已披露营收。

description.en: The model holds the latest reported standalone quarter’s diluted weighted-average share count constant.
description.zh: 模型固定采用本季已披露的加权平均摊薄股数。

label.en: ASML quarterly US GAAP statements · revenue and diluted shares
label.zh: ASML 季度 US GAAP 财报：营收与摊薄股数

label.en: SEC company facts · financial and share disclosures
label.zh: SEC 公司财务数据：财务和股数披露

method_note.en: Growth, normalized net margin and forward P/E are research assumptions. Multiples reflect the expected persistence of earnings and company-specific risk. The denominator is held constant across scenarios.
method_note.zh: 增长、常态净利率和远期市盈率均为研究假设。倍数反映对盈利持续性和公司特有风险的判断。三个情景使用相同股数。

rationale.en: Customer fab schedules slip and systems mix weakens.
rationale.zh: 客户晶圆厂建设延后，系统销售组合转弱。

rationale.en: EUV deliveries and installed-base services expand as planned.
rationale.zh: EUV 设备交付和装机服务按计划增长。

rationale.en: EUV adoption and productivity upgrades drive stronger revenue and mix.
rationale.zh: EUV 应用和生产率升级推动营收及产品组合改善。
